limitations: Prefix behavior is observed through native Prometheus counter deltas after model quiescence; no independent numerical model reference runs in this client.
Timings are diagnostic request observations, not serving-throughput acceptance measurements.
Cancellation and reusable-resource counts are observed through native metrics; individual request generations and CUDA fences remain internal.
PNG decoding and output consistency are exercised; synthetic fixture images have no semantic caption oracle.
A stalled TCP reader can be absorbed by socket buffers. Output-queue backpressure is reported only when native failure/cancellation counters actually increase.
